description: A chunky low-poly military off-road motorbike parked upright on the ground on its two wheels, no rider, seen from the front-left. A slim boxy fuel tank and flat seat on a sturdy tubular frame, a small blocky engine block low in the middle, a tall front fork with wide flat handlebars and a small square headlight on the front of the fork, a short flat front mudguard over the front wheel and a flat rear mudguard, a boxy saddlebag hanging from the left side of the rear seat and an exhaust pipe running along the left side under the seat. Two large chunky knobbly wheels of the same size, front and rear. Fuel tank, mudguards and saddlebag painted one desert tan; frame, fork, handlebars, engine block and exhaust dark gunmetal grey; seat black; tyres dark charcoal, hubs dark grey; headlight lens pale grey. The tail light on the rear face faces away and is hidden; the right-hand side of the bike faces away and is hidden.
proportions: About 2.2 m long, 0.9 m wide and 1.2 m tall; both wheels clearly visible. (length : width : height = 2.44 : 1 : 1.33)
sides: the combat bike is symmetric left to right except the boxy tan saddlebag, which hangs from the LEFT side of the rear seat only, and the exhaust pipe, which runs along the LEFT side under the seat only; nothing hangs on the right side of the rear seat.
